Proffieboard detected via USB but serial port access is blocked. Add yourself to the dialout group, then reboot:
sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER  
Proffieboard flashing requires udev rules to allow USB device access. Install them, then reload udev (no reboot needed):
cd ~/.arduino15/packages/proffieboard/hardware/stm32l4 && cd */drivers/linux && sudo cp *.rules /etc/udev/rules.d && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules && sudo udevadm trigger  
disconnected 0
First-time setup: downloading and installing required build tools. This only happens once and may take several minutes on slower connections. Compile and flash will be available when setup is complete.

Import Sound Font


    

      
Pick a sound font as it came from the vendor with preference for the original .zip download. JMT Studio keeps the archive intact and lets you choose which fonts inside to add to your library.

      

        
        
      

      
Already have many fonts to add? Bulk import from a folder

    


    

      
Importing source…

      

      

      

      
Based on bench tests, folder imports typically run 5-10x slower than zip imports because every file has to be read individually to confirm uniqueness. If you still have the original .zip from the vendor, importing that is much faster. Keeping your purchases zipped is the cleanest way to archive them long-term.

    Based on bench tests, folder imports typically run 5-10x slower than zip imports because every file inside has to be read individually to confirm each source is unique. If you still have the original vendor .zip files somewhere, importing that folder is much faster. Keeping purchases zipped is the cleanest way to archive them long-term.

    Merge backup into your library
    
    
     
    
    
    
    
    
      
      
    
    
  
    

    



    
  
    
    
    Import Sound Font library backup
    
    
     
    
    
    Merge adds what's in the backup to your library. Items that already match are left alone. When an item exists in both but the contents differ, you'll choose to keep yours, use the backup's version, or keep both (renamed). Shared tracks merge silently: any tracks from the backup that you don't already have are added, and your existing tracks are kept as-is.
    Replace wipes your current library and restores the backup exactly. This cannot be undone.

      Clear Compile Cache 
      
    
    
    
    
      
    
        Delete all cached compile results?
    
        Cached builds let the app skip recompiling unchanged configs. Clearing the cache means
        your next compile for each config will run from scratch — up to 10–15 minutes for
        complex builds.

    
        This does not affect your config files.
